classification.mode: Disjoint stack stages within explicit half-open marker windows. Region truncation excludes outer callback ancestors.
classification.observerRegion: Leaf frame through last LoopConsumerObservation or MethodBlockRuntime.observe frame.
classification.C5Region: Leaf frame through last native C5/prepare/EntryRestrictionTicket frame inside that observer region. Outer AP limit and protection callbacks do not classify inner query work as field-limit work.
classification.priority: See exact embedded interpreter source. C5 uses mark/restrict/prepare/path-index/union/bookkeeping stages; writer binding separates matching/application/field-limit/selection; local publication separates matching/index admission/snapshot-enqueue.
classification.JavaSamples: ExecutionSample events with a Java stack. Percentages exclude native GC/JIT CPU samples captured separately in collapsed summaries.
classification.allocationWeight: ObjectAllocationSample weight; estimated allocation churn, not retained heap or exact allocated bytes.

readerReceipt.classificationCaveat: C5 operation region ends at its last C5 frame; outer AP limit callbacks do not classify inner query work as field limiting.

limits: Stack shares are sampled Java CPU; do not multiply them by wall time or call them exact process CPU.
Disjoint fine stages sum to each stated Java denominator. Inclusive source-line rows and parent frames overlap.
Allocation weights estimate churn; neither weights nor logical row counts are retained memory.
Some methods inline; low mark-matching sample count is not a count of wrong-mark rejects. Current counters do not separate mark rejection from path/fixed-entry rejection.
Repeated recording snapshots overlap. Never add windows from different snapshots to estimate total work.
Selected-event envelopes do not prove a rolling recording retained all events in a window.
Captures and derivatives remain on disk; no raw cleanup is performed.
